integrity: The all-parameter theorem is proved analytically using Fejer-Riesz factorization, a path-eigenvalue extremal argument, an explicit positive dual contact measure, finite-dimensional linear-programming duality, and a Chebyshev-Vandermonde uniqueness step. The included finite checker is corroborative only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies exactly when the finite cyclic grid has no relaxation gap for the full harmonic interval from 2 through n, with n at least 3. It does not give a closed formula for the strict off-mesh excess, and some off-mesh instances can be unbounded because of aliasing.
title: Exact no-loss meshes for the full Carathéodory–Fejér interval problem
